class.name: SpatialInventoryActions
class.brief_description: Moves, transfers, and splits placed items between inventory grids.
class.description: Set callbacks to apply game rules when an item leaves or enters a grid. Attach a stack adapter when the game owns stack quantities separately from placements.

members.member: Optional adapter that describes stack quantities and commits their changes together with grid placements. Defaults to [code]null[/code].

Optional callback that receives the item ID, unrotated footprint, rotation, origin, and source grid before a pickup. Return an empty String to allow it or a reason to deny it. The default empty callable allows pickups that pass the grid checks.

Optional callback that receives the item and proposed destination placement, including the action and any swap target. Return an empty String to allow it or a reason to deny it. The default empty callable allows placements that pass the grid checks.

Optional callback that checks each candidate grid during a quick transfer. It receives the transfer context. Return an empty String to consider the grid or a reason to skip it. The default empty callable considers every eligible grid.

Optional callback used when a quick transfer receives an empty destination list. It receives the source item context and returns an Array of destination grids in priority order. The default empty callable supplies no destinations.

Optional callback that receives the source grid and the destination grid, which can be [code]null[/code]. Return [code]true[/code] to allow the operation. The default empty callable applies no additional guard.
Whether automatic placement may try a rotated footprint when looking for a fit.
